updates.statement: A failed gate leaves a machine-local failure receipt for its workspace naming first-attempt failed, retry-recovered and runner-reported unreached nodes, and every shard of the run that did not pass with its exit code, its runner-reported failed checks and, for a skipped shard, the prerequisites it was skipped after; the failed operation result lists the same shards. Failed shards and checks are reported, not owed. Unreached nodes fail their shard. The next gate in that workspace accepts a remembered node that an observation in a change journal the workspace changed names as evidence with its root cause, whatever its shard selection. Otherwise its shard must be selected again, or the gate refuses before running checks, and the node must report passing in that run, unless that shard passes without reporting it, the workspace changed its test file since its base and that file no longer holds its test; such a vanished node is released and its shard's receipt details name it. A retry success never offsets a first failure. A passing shard may also release an unreported owed node reported not_collected when its file changed since the failure tip; receipt details bind the last retiring commit and basis. Runners omitting not_collected retain the name-absence heuristic and journal release.

decisions.reason: The owner approved proposal C. Derive retirement at the first collecting gate rather than re-judging function names at a later tip; retain optional runner compatibility. A side ledger or required journal ceremony adds redundant authority. Reopen if a runner cannot distinguish excluded files from collected files.
